name: react-tools
title: React Tools
description: Skills and an agent for refactoring React codebases: component decomposition, migration to hooks, format-on-save.
author: Kyiv Frontend Guild
body:
React Tools is a collection of tools for working with React code in Claude Code. The plugin targets large codebases where manual refactoring is expensive.

The main /refactor skill analyzes the selected component, proposes safe decomposition steps, and applies them with a diff preview.

The react-analyzer agent builds a dependency map of components and highlights problem areas: unnecessary re-renders, prop drilling, hook anti-patterns.

changelog.summary: Added the component-audit skill and React 19 Server Components support.
Fixed false positives from the hook linter on useEffect.

name: refactor
title: Refactor Component
description: Step-by-step refactor of the selected React component with a diff preview.
author: Kyiv Frontend Guild
body:
This skill accepts a path to a component or the currently open file. It first builds an AST and identifies the boundaries of logical blocks.

It then proposes a plan: extracting subcomponents, lifting state, replacing classes with functions and hooks. Each step is shown as a diff before it's applied.

name: component-audit
title: Component Audit
description: Audits a component for anti-patterns and performance problems.
author: Kyiv Frontend Guild
body:
Checks the component against a best-practices checklist: rules of hooks, memoization, accessibility.

The result is a report with prioritized findings and links to the relevant paved-path rules.

name: react-analyzer
title: React Analyzer
description: Agent that builds a map of components and dependencies in the project.
author: Kyiv Frontend Guild
body:
react-analyzer scans the src directory, builds a component import graph, and identifies re-render hot spots.

Used as context for other skills, or on its own for code review.

name: migrate-hooks
title: Migrate to Hooks
description: Automatic migration of class components to functional components with hooks.
author: Kyiv Frontend Guild
body: Converts lifecycle methods to useEffect/useMemo while preserving semantics, and flags places that need manual review.

name: on-save-format
title: Format on Save
description: Hook that runs the formatter after every file save.
author: Kyiv Frontend Guild
body: Fires on the save event and runs prettier/eslint --fix for the changed files.

name: engineering-paved-path
title: Engineering Paved Path
description: The team's canonical standards: React, testing, and API design rules, pulled in as context by other plugins.
author: Platform Team
body:
Paved Path is the team's "paved road": a set of reference skills with standards that other plugins depend on.

The skills don't perform actions — they provide structured context of the rules. This keeps a single source of truth for best practices.

changelog.summary: Updated testing rules for the new Vitest version.
Added the api-design skill with REST versioning rules.

name: react-best-practices
title: React Best Practices
description: Rules for writing React components, hooks, and state management.
author: Platform Team
body: A reference of rules: composition over inheritance, minimizing state, correct effect dependencies, accessibility.

name: testing-standards
title: Testing Standards
description: The team's unit and integration testing standards.
author: Platform Team
body: Describes the test pyramid, naming, working with mocks, and target coverage for critical paths.

name: api-design
title: API Design
description: Rules for designing and versioning REST/RPC APIs.
author: Platform Team
body: Resource naming conventions, error codes, pagination, backward compatibility, and deprecations.

name: mcp-postgres
title: Postgres MCP
description: MCP server for safe read-only access to Postgres: schema inspection, query explain, supervised selects.
author: Data Platform
body:
Postgres MCP gives Claude Code controlled access to a database via the Model Context Protocol.

By default the server runs read-only and requires an explicit table allow-list. No DDL/DML without a separate permission.

changelog.summary: Added the explain-plan tool and schema caching.

name: postgres-server
title: postgres-server
description: MCP server with query, schema, and explain-plan tools.
author: Data Platform
body:
The server connects via DATABASE_URL and exposes tools for schema inspection and safe SELECT queries.

All queries go through a whitelist and a row limit.

name: commit-helper
title: Commit Helper
description: Generates conventional commits from a diff and keeps messages clean via a pre-commit hook.
author: DevEx
body:
Commit Helper looks at staged changes and proposes a message in Conventional Commits format.

A pre-commit hook blocks commits that don't follow the convention and suggests a fix.

changelog.summary: Support for scoped commits and custom types.

name: commit
title: Smart Commit
description: Creates a commit message from the staged diff.
author: DevEx
body: Reads git diff --staged, classifies the changes, and forms a title + body in Conventional Commits style.

name: pre-commit-lint
title: Pre-commit Lint
description: Hook that validates the commit message before it's written.
author: DevEx
body: Checks the title format, line length, and presence of a type. Rejects invalid commits with an explanation.

name: docs-writer
title: Docs Writer
description: Writes and reviews documentation: API references from code, changelogs, and markdown style checks.
author: Docs Guild
body:
Docs Writer automates documentation chores: generating references from signatures, assembling changelogs, and proofreading text.

The doc-reviewer agent checks tone, term consistency, and broken links.

changelog.summary: Full rewrite of the API-docs generator on top of TSDoc.

name: api-docs
title: API Docs
description: Generates a markdown reference from TSDoc/JSDoc comments.
author: Docs Guild
body: Parses comments and types, builds reference pages with usage examples.

name: changelog
title: Changelog
description: Assembles a changelog from commit history between tags.
author: Docs Guild
body: Groups commits by type (feat/fix/…) and forms a release section in Keep a Changelog format.

name: doc-reviewer
title: Doc Reviewer
description: Agent that reviews documentation for style and broken links.
author: Docs Guild
body: Checks tone, terminology consistency, broken internal links, and stale examples.

name: security-scan
title: Security Scan
description: A SAST agent and hooks that catch vulnerabilities and secrets before they reach the repository.
author: Security
body:
Security Scan is a set of security tools: static code analysis and git-hook-level safeguards.

The plugin is in beta: rules are still being calibrated, false positives are possible.

changelog.summary: First public beta release: vuln-scanner + secret-guard.

name: vuln-scanner
title: Vulnerability Scanner
description: Static analysis of code for known vulnerability patterns.
author: Security
body: Scans the codebase against a set of SAST rules and produces a report with severity and recommendations.

name: pre-push-scan
title: Pre-push Scan
description: Hook that runs a quick scan before push.
author: Security
body: Blocks the push on high/critical severity findings.

name: secret-guard
title: Secret Guard
description: Hook that prevents committing keys and tokens.
author: Security
body: Checks the diff against secret patterns (API keys, private keys) and stops the commit.
